items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: The gentleman that formed the band, Al Vollmer, he’s a physician, dentist. And somehow or another me and him, we sort of, I guess you might say bumped each other.

ctx.x: How long have you been working with these guys?

Well let me see now, this June it’s been about oh maybe five or maybe six months. We kind of got into lock with each other. Let me see, how did it happen? The gentleman that formed the band, Al Vollmer, he’s a physician, dentist. And somehow or another me and him, we sort of, I guess you might say bumped each other. You know.
